answer: The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in grove, expire in dune, and onyx lists each expiry. An adversary running 194 aliases as a result needs 82 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2533 identities would post 4375 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
